```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 14_anova_f_distribution
title: >
  Why is F always positive?
questions:
  - id: why_f_positive
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      Why is the F statistic always positive?
    answer: >
      F is a ratio of mean squares, and mean squares are variances based on squared
      deviations. Squared quantities cannot be negative.
    explanation: >
      This is also why F distributions are positively skewed rather than symmetrical
      around zero.
```
